hooks.name: Verify No Absolute Paths on Save
hooks.description: Check for absolute local paths on file save to enforce Kiroween compliance

action.command: powershell -Command "if (Select-String -Path $env:FILE_PATH -Pattern '(C:\\Users|/home/|~/workspace)' -Quiet) { Write-Error 'WARNING: Absolute path detected in saved file'; exit 2 }"
